QuestInfo.name: Cash for Levels
QuestInfo.0: All those sweet levels, lost to the treachery of the Black Mage. If only there were an easier way...
QuestInfo.1: #p1401000# had just the thing. A container, not of liquid or gas, but of... EXP! This new Maple World technology is great! #bOpen it now#k!
QuestInfo.2: You got a quick level up to... level 18?! Wait, you were supposed to go to 70!

0.0: Leveling yourself will be no easy task, but I suspect you hold a weapon in your arsenal more powerful than most.\r\n#L0##bA weapon?#l\n#k
0.1: I am speaking of money, master. Were you not able to afford the #m150000000#? Do you not have a host of servants under your employ?\r\n#L0##bBut... Mesos don't make you level up...#l\n#k
0.2: Ah, my dear master, you are living in the past. Please drink this.

yes.0: This potion was created for a special event some time ago, but I purchased it from a local ruffian. It will come with the accumulated power of that amazing traveler. Come now, give a cheers to victory!

1.0: Just drink the whole thing, you big baby. #bOpen the inventory and double-click on the bottle#k.
1.1: You must drink the entire bottle before you go anywhere else.
